roadmap.title: Chapters 1–4: begin collecting and upgrading
roadmap.description: Before starting, open the Botanist, Curiosities collector, Big sister, and Resource sharing checklists and follow their chapter headings. Collect upgrade supplies from Chapter 2 onward and raise Pocket capacity early. Complete the practice pots, Hugo’s apple, and orchard hide-and-seek along the way.

roadmap.title: Chapters 5–8: battlefield and castle
roadmap.description: Save the trapped soldier, visit the castle tomb, and follow the four checklists. Save rare crafting materials for the sling and equipment, while keeping the Luminosa needed to reach alchemist carts.

roadmap.title: Chapters 9–12: university and estate
roadmap.description: Use the university’s front doors and spare both wounded soldiers at the estate. Finish the gift checklist in Chapter 12. Keep collecting supplies and defer Alchemy upgrades while the sling or equipment still needs work.

roadmap.title: Chapters 13–17: finish and recover omissions
roadmap.description: Collect Black Nightshade in Chapter 14, then restart the garden checkpoint for Captain Sidekick. Visit Rodric’s forge before pushing the cart in Chapter 16. Finish the collectible checklists, both upgrade trees, and the epilogue. Use chapter replay for omissions; for upgrade supplies, replay consecutive chapters from an earlier inventory instead of jumping between chapters. If an earned achievement is delayed, restart the game and load your save.

steps.text: Play through @loc{Chapter 17: For Each Other} to its end.

achievements.summary: Collect six flowers for Hugo’s herbarium.

steps.text: Follow the Botanist checklist for six flowers. The first six are available by @loc{Chapter 9}, ending with @item{Lavender}.
steps.note: If you leave a flower behind, replay its chapter to collect it.

achievements.summary: Collect all 13 flowers for Hugo’s herbarium.

guide.context: Chapter replay recovers missed items. A pickup stays registered even if you leave before finishing the chapter.

collectibles.name: Carnations
collectibles.location: Church courtyard
collectibles.method: Walk over to @npc{Hugo} when he stops to examine the flowers.

collectibles.name: Aquilegia
collectibles.location: Behind Laurentius’s house
collectibles.method: Go past the horse and wagon to the rear of the house. Pick the purple flowers under the birch tree.

collectibles.name: Gladiolus
collectibles.location: Side trail before the aqueduct
collectibles.method: After ducking beneath the log, stop before going under the aqueduct. Take the trail on the left back toward the log to reach the flowers.

collectibles.name: Hawthorn
collectibles.location: Ruined village before the hideout
collectibles.method: Before passing the village well, take the path to the right. Search inside the ruined house.

collectibles.name: St. John's Wort
collectibles.location: Tree where the group hangs the medallions
collectibles.method: After the group’s conversation, turn back to @npc{Hugo} and collect the flowers he is examining.
collectibles.note: Do this before returning to the sleeping quarters.

collectibles.name: Lavender
collectibles.location: Opening woodland path with Mélie
collectibles.method: Stop before climbing over the stone wall. Turn around and look behind the tree on your right.
collectibles.group: Chapter 9 — In the Shadow of Ramparts

collectibles.name: Daisy
collectibles.location: Third guarded room in the university
collectibles.method: When Amicia mentions roses, turn the spotlight away from the rats’ corridor. Use @item{Odoris} to draw the rats onto the two guards. Block the rats’ return with the spotlight, then search their former corridor.

collectibles.name: Rhododendron
collectibles.location: Lower castle courtyard
collectibles.method: Climb down the ladder after @npc{Rodric}. Turn right twice to the lower orange section, then look beside the unlit movable brazier.
collectibles.note: Take this detour before joining Rodric in the courtyard’s center.

collectibles.name: Cinquefoils
collectibles.location: Balcony above the estate gardens
collectibles.method: After leaving the ruined house, follow the balcony left to its dead end. Collect the flowers before descending the garden stairs.

collectibles.name: Daffodil
collectibles.location: Path beyond the horse carriage
collectibles.method: After the dream, pass the wagon guarded by two soldiers. Continue beyond the horse carriage and take the small opening on the right.

collectibles.name: Black Nightshade
collectibles.location: Far-right hedge enclosure in the garden
collectibles.method: While following @npc{Nicholas}, detour into the hedge enclosure at the far-right corner and collect the flower.
collectibles.note: Then restart at the garden checkpoint for Captain Sidekick. The flower remains collected after the restart.

collectibles.name: Rockfoils
collectibles.location: Storage room beside Lucas
collectibles.method: At the start of the chapter, enter the doorway to @npc{Lucas}’s left. Turn right and search the back of the room.

collectibles.name: Christmas Rose
collectibles.location: Path behind the gate opened by reinforcements
collectibles.method: While @npc{Rodric} forces the burning house’s door, defeat the soldiers who emerge from the lower gate. Go through that gate and search the path beyond.
collectibles.note: Collect the flower before entering the burning house.

steps.text: Use the Curiosities collector checklist to find 13 curiosities. The @item{Horseshoe} in @loc{Chapter 7} is the earliest halfway point.
steps.note: Chapter replay lets you recover any curiosity you passed.

guide.context: Chapter replay recovers missed items. A pickup stays registered even if you leave before finishing the chapter.

collectibles.name: Spices
collectibles.location: Loft above the kitchen and laundry area
collectibles.method: From the estate’s entrance hall, go through the dining room toward the kitchen. Climb the ladder in the laundry area and inspect the table.

collectibles.name: Tablecloth
collectibles.location: Bed in Amicia’s bedroom
collectibles.method: Go upstairs and follow @npc{Louise} along the hall to Amicia’s room. Take the cloth from the bed.
collectibles.note: Do this before entering Beatrice’s room.

collectibles.name: Soap
collectibles.location: Yard beside the village stream
collectibles.method: At the first street junction, turn right and cross the small stone bridge. Take the immediate right into the yard and search the stool beside the stream.

collectibles.name: Incense and Herbs
collectibles.location: Upstairs bedroom in Clervie’s house
collectibles.method: Search the small table against the left wall at the far end of the bedroom.
collectibles.note: Inspect the table before opening the chest of clothes.

collectibles.name: Brew
collectibles.location: Side room beside the swinging brazier
collectibles.method: Climb the ladder and shoot the brazier’s chain so it swings. Return below and time your crossing to vault the wooden barrier in the barred doorway. Inspect the cauldron on the side room’s table.

collectibles.name: Crusader Tabard
collectibles.location: Upper walkway where Hugo lowers a ladder
collectibles.method: After reuniting with @npc{Hugo}, climb his ladder. Search the open crate against the wall above.

collectibles.name: Hermetic Vessel
collectibles.location: Lakeside campsite near the opening windmill
collectibles.method: Leave the road through the broken fence toward the lake. Pass the dock and find the smoking campfire. Search beside the stump marked with a red hand.

collectibles.name: Vitriol
collectibles.location: Apprentice’s bedroom in Laurentius’s house
collectibles.method: Go upstairs and enter the farther of the two doorways. Inspect the desk.

collectibles.name: Sickle
collectibles.location: Chest beside the lone soldier after the upright siege tower
collectibles.method: Push the lit brazier cart left toward the soldier. Kill him and search the chest beside his position.

collectibles.name: Oliphant
collectibles.location: Bodies near the fallen siege tower
collectibles.method: After dropping the two hanging bodies to distract the rats, search left near where the bodies land. The curiosity is beside the corpses and an open chest.
collectibles.note: Search before entering the fallen tower.

collectibles.name: Pound Sterling
collectibles.location: Archer post along the camp palisade
collectibles.method: After Mélie opens the chest in the red tent, turn right before following her into the mess tent. Inspect the table beside the crossbow.

collectibles.name: Declaration of War
collectibles.location: White smithing tent in the lower camp
collectibles.method: After recovering the sling, find the central tent with an anvil. Take the document from the stool.

collectibles.name: Horseshoe
collectibles.location: Locked hut beside the watermill workbench
collectibles.method: Look through the opening beside the workbench and shoot the chain securing the hut’s shutter. Return to the lower mill lever and climb through the open window. Take the horseshoe from the wall.

collectibles.name: Map
collectibles.location: Far-right guard camp after the Devorantis lesson
collectibles.method: Circle behind the camp’s white canopy. Throw a pot to distract the two guards, then take the map from their table.

collectibles.name: Iconography
collectibles.location: Top of the first spiral staircase
collectibles.method: Before following @npc{Hugo} down toward Lucas’s laboratory, inspect the rubble beside the stair entrance.

collectibles.name: Bird Language Manual
collectibles.location: Castle wall where Mélie waits
collectibles.method: Speak to @npc{Mélie}, then look behind the barrel she stood beside.

collectibles.name: Sheepskin
collectibles.location: Chest inside the house with a hanging man
collectibles.method: Shoot the body’s chain to draw the rats away. Break the arriving guard’s lantern, then reach the chest near the doorway he used.
collectibles.group: Chapter 9 — In the Shadow of Ramparts
collectibles.note: If rats still block the chest, clear them with Luminosa.

collectibles.name: Piece of Transis
collectibles.location: Ruined mausoleum in the cemetery
collectibles.method: Before pushing the crate toward the exit ledge, turn behind the crate. Climb over the low wall and search the mausoleum.
collectibles.group: Chapter 9 — In the Shadow of Ramparts

collectibles.name: Study of a Skinned Person
collectibles.location: Right-hand seats in the lecture hall
collectibles.method: After the guards escort Rodric out, move along the right side of the tiered seating. Search the seats near the remaining guard’s line of sight.

collectibles.name: Theriaque
collectibles.location: Side room off the lower library vault
collectibles.method: After rescuing @npc{Rodric}, search the far-left corner of the vault at floor level. Pass through the gap between the bookshelves and inspect the side room’s table.

collectibles.name: Harnois Helmet
collectibles.location: Trunk in the ruined estate’s second room
collectibles.method: After the rat-whirlwind fight, carry Lucas’s torch into the house. Pass the first untouched servant’s body. In the next room, search the open trunk beyond the second body.

collectibles.name: Family Tree
collectibles.location: Right side of Beatrice’s underground laboratory
collectibles.method: Before joining Lucas at the back, look beside the two boilers beneath the lion painting, just right of the room’s center.

collectibles.name: Rag Doll
collectibles.location: Hole in the left wall of the dream village
collectibles.method: When Clervie opens a door, stop before following her. Crouch through the hole to your left and collect the doll.

collectibles.name: Knight Figurine
collectibles.location: Desk in Beatrice’s dream study
collectibles.method: In Hugo’s bedroom, take the adjoining route into Beatrice’s study and inspect the central desk.
collectibles.note: Collect the figurine before approaching Hugo.

collectibles.name: Discipline
collectibles.location: Right-hand alley after Hugo defeats two armored guards
collectibles.method: Before climbing the short stairs the guards protected, turn into the alley on the right. Search beside the dead knight.

collectibles.name: Inquisitor's Manual
collectibles.location: Right side of the gallows near the cathedral
collectibles.method: After the cart section, clear the guards near the gallows. Search beside the dead knight to the gallows’ right before going up the stairs.

achievements.description: Find all the gifts for the orphans
achievements.summary: Collect all 11 gifts for the orphans.

guide.context: Chapter replay recovers missed items. A pickup stays registered even if you leave before finishing the chapter.

collectibles.name: Whistle
collectibles.location: Loft above the far stable stall
collectibles.method: Climb the ladder in the farthest stall. Take the whistle from the planks covered by a red cloth.

collectibles.name: Amulets and Talismans
collectibles.location: Wooden dock outside the village
collectibles.method: Before entering the village, turn right toward the river. Walk behind the buildings and search the dock’s boards.

collectibles.name: Rosary
collectibles.location: Starting church, right of the altar
collectibles.method: Head toward the blocked doorway to the altar’s right. Take the rosary from the stone table beneath the wall statue.

collectibles.name: Diary of an Alchemist
collectibles.location: Wrecked boat beside the orchard
collectibles.method: After leaving the sawmill, turn right at the orchard entrance toward the water. Search beside the dead fisherman and broken boat.
collectibles.note: Take this detour before searching for Hugo.

collectibles.name: Ballastella
collectibles.location: Unlit campfire beside the trebuchet stairs
collectibles.method: After Lucas lowers the burning brazier, light the stick Hugo fetched. Go left of the stairs to the campfire with a sword in it. Light the fire and take the gift beside it.
collectibles.note: The stick burns quickly. Fetch another from Hugo afterward if you need one to continue.

collectibles.name: Knucklebones
collectibles.location: Canopied table beside the sleeping soldiers’ tent
collectibles.method: After Arthur’s second distraction, cross the tent full of bottles. From its second room, go left outside to the table under the attached canopy.
collectibles.note: Wait for the patrolling soldier to walk away from the table.

collectibles.name: Vinegar of the Four Thieves
collectibles.location: Stone hut outside Château d’Ombrage
collectibles.method: After leaving the underground aqueduct, climb the stairs toward the castle. Turn back at the top toward the hut, have @npc{Mélie} unlock its door, and search the table.

collectibles.name: Alchemical Crucible
collectibles.location: Base of the second spiral staircase
collectibles.method: After returning from Lucas’s laboratory to the sleeping quarters, follow Hugo into the next room. Look left before climbing its staircase.

collectibles.name: Chessboard
collectibles.location: Guarded table to the right of the university entrance
collectibles.method: Follow the two patrolling guards to their alcove. Hit the helmeted guard with @item{Devorantis}, kill the unhelmeted soldier with a rock, then shoot the first guard’s exposed head. Take the chessboard from the table.
collectibles.group: Chapter 9 — In the Shadow of Ramparts

collectibles.name: Reading Stone
collectibles.location: Table near the armor crate during the library escape
collectibles.method: After the first Rodric takedown lesson, clear the next room by distracting its guard for Rodric. Turn the corner beside the armor crate and search the table near a chest.

collectibles.name: Calamus
collectibles.location: First rat-filled house above the burning cart
collectibles.method: Throw @item{Odoris} toward the fenced yard to draw the house’s rats outside. Light the campfire with @item{Ignifir} to block their return. Crawl into the house and take the gift from the table.

achievements.summary: Reach level 3 in both sling upgrade categories.

guide.context: Chapter selection restores the materials and upgrades you originally had at that chapter. New supplies carry forward only when you play consecutive chapters; repeatedly loading a chapter does not build a stockpile.

steps.text: From @loc{Chapter 2}, gather leather, fabric, cord, and tools. Raise @mechanic{Pocket} to at least level 2 early so you can hold the supplies needed for later upgrades.
At workbenches, buy every level of @mechanic{Strings} and @mechanic{Pouch}. Defer Alchemy upgrades and limit optional Somnum and Luminosa crafting.
steps.note: Keep enough Luminosa for the carts in Resource sharing.

steps.text: If you finish with sling upgrades missing, select @loc{Chapter 9} and play Chapters 9–12 consecutively, collecting supplies for the sling. Continue into later chapters if needed.

achievements.summary: Reach level 3 in every equipment upgrade category.

guide.context: Selecting an earlier chapter restores its original inventory and upgrades. Play consecutive chapters to carry newly gathered materials forward; skipping between selected chapters will not combine their supplies.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Pocket} early to carry more materials. Collect fabric, leather, cord, and tools as you explore.
steps.note: Useful tools are beside the Chapter 3 workbench after the spiral stairs, above Hugo’s reunion ladder, and by the Chapter 8 sleeping-room workbench.

steps.text: Buy levels 1–3 of @mechanic{Pocket}, @mechanic{Ammunition Bag}, and @mechanic{Attirail}. Save Alchemy upgrades until the equipment and sling are finished.
If materials run short, select @loc{Chapter 9} and replay Chapters 9–12 in sequence, spending on unfinished equipment. Continue forward if you still need supplies.

achievements.summary: Craft 100 ammunition projectiles across any combination of types.

steps.text: Craft ammunition as you play. When common materials fill your inventory, turn spare supplies into @item{Ignifir}.
steps.note: Avoid wasting fabric and leather on optional Somnum or Luminosa while you still need gear upgrades.

guide.context: You must walk inside each cart for credit. Replay the relevant chapter if you pass a cart without entering.

collectibles.name: Alchemist Cart 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 7}: Lucas’s Luminosa tutorial beyond the portcullis
collectibles.method: Clear the rats with @item{Luminosa}, then walk into the cart.

collectibles.name: Alchemist Cart 2
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 9}: side alley beyond the stream bridge after the slums
collectibles.method: Behind the two guards across the bridge, take the alley on the left. Turn left again and vault the wall. Use @item{Luminosa} on the rats and enter the cart beyond.

collectibles.name: Alchemist Cart 3
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10}: courtyard outside the library after the Extinguis lesson
collectibles.method: Go down the stairs and past the low bushes. Vault the wooden fence ahead, then turn right. Clear the rats with @item{Luminosa} and step inside the cart.

collectibles.name: Alchemist Cart 4
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12}: garden detour after burning the wheat bundles
collectibles.method: After lighting the next torch, turn around toward the distant cart. Ignite the spotlight beside it with @item{Ignifir}. Draw the rats aside with @item{Odoris}, then cross to the light and enter the cart.

collectibles.name: Alchemist Cart 5
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16}: alley behind the first house on the right inside the city
collectibles.method: After the first armored guard and the city gate, go behind the first house on your right. Kill the armored guard at the alley’s end and enter the cart.

achievements.summary: Destroy all six practice pots behind the estate stables in Chapter 1.

steps.text: After returning to the estate, take the passage behind the stables. Use the sling to smash the six pots set up on the barrels; replenish rocks from the nearby supply.
steps.note: The forest apple exercise does not count. If you leave the estate first, replay Chapter 1.

achievements.summary: Give Hugo an apple in the Chapter 2 village.

steps.text: In the village, pass the doors marked with white crosses. Turn right into the yard with an apple tree and take an apple for @npc{Hugo}.
steps.note: Do this before the market chase. Replay Chapter 2 if you pass the yard.

achievements.summary: Scare Hugo without being seen during hide-and-seek in Chapter 4.

steps.text: When Hugo runs off after the sawmill, crouch along the orchard’s far-left edge. Around the sixth row, look inward for him behind a tree.
Approach @npc{Hugo} from behind without being spotted and use the scare prompt.
steps.note: If he sees you, restart the checkpoint immediately or replay Chapter 4 for another attempt.

achievements.summary: Keep the trapped soldier alive while crossing the fallen siege tower in Chapter 5.

steps.text: Inside the fallen tower, stop just beyond the first broken wall. Place your torch in the sconce behind you on the left.
Use @item{Ignifir} to light the unlit torch beside the trapped soldier.
Retrieve your torch and leave the tower while the soldier remains protected.
steps.note: Moving on without lighting his torch lets the rats kill him. Restart the checkpoint immediately or replay Chapter 5 if he dies.

achievements.summary: Visit the tomb beneath the castle in Chapter 8.

steps.text: After visiting Lucas’s laboratory, return to the spiral stairs and keep going down. Approach the tomb at the bottom and let the conversation finish.
steps.note: If you finish the castle visit without finding the tomb, replay Chapter 8.

achievements.summary: Enter the university through its front doors in Chapter 9.

steps.text: Stay hidden near the university’s front entrance. Hit one armored guard with @item{Devorantis}, then shoot his exposed head with a rock. Do the same to the second guard.
steps.note: If the guards raise their shields, retreat and hide before attacking again.

steps.text: Go through the main doors once the entrance is clear.
steps.note: The side entrance skips this achievement. Replay Chapter 9 if you used it.

achievements.summary: Leave both wounded soldiers alive in Chapter 12’s spotlight section.

steps.text: After guiding Lucas across with the spotlight, leave the first wounded soldier’s lantern intact. Use @item{Odoris} to move the rats away from your route.
At the next light near the wagon, keep the second soldier’s torch burning. Use more @item{Odoris} and hurry to the wooden door.
Get through the door with Lucas while both soldiers are alive.
steps.note: If you destroy either soldier’s light, restart the checkpoint immediately or replay Chapter 12. If both survived but no achievement appears, restart the game and load the save.

achievements.summary: Beat Nicholas to the room he closes off in Chapter 14.

steps.text: At the garden checkpoint, collect @item{Black Nightshade} first if you need the flower. Restart the checkpoint afterward to begin the pursuit again.
steps.note: The flower stays collected after the restart.

steps.text: While Nicholas pauses to speak with the guards, cross the garden to the doorway at the far end. Hurry along the hall and through the second doorway before he closes it.
Immediately hide under the cloth-covered table on your right to avoid the guard.
steps.note: If Nicholas closes the route and forces you toward the stairs, restart at the garden checkpoint or replay Chapter 14.

achievements.summary: Visit Rodric’s old forge in Chapter 16.

steps.text: After the burning house and the two captive civilians, stop before pushing the cart toward the archers. Go right around the burning rubble and duck beneath the rat growth. Look over the growth at the dead end and shoot the chain holding the iron gate.
Return to the gate from the other side. Follow @npc{Rodric} down the alley to the forge and wait for the conversation to finish.
steps.note: Pushing the cart advances past this detour. Replay Chapter 16 if you already moved on.
